property_summary: After calling setOwner, the owner should equal the passed argument, not the caller.
Only the admin can change the owner; after a non-admin call, the owner stays the same.
After any call to setOwner, the caller must be the new owner, unless revert.
After setOwner is called by a non-admin, the owner must remain unchanged (the caller must not become the new owner).
setOwner succeeds only when called by the admin
After any call to setOwner, the owner must be the address that was passed as the argument.
